index.why: The app shell: entry chunk, its static imports and their CSS, raw bytes, recorded by `npm run bundle:record`. Every screen is a lazy route chunk. `slack` absorbs chunk-name noise in the preload table; `cap` is the hard limit, raised only with a maintainer's agreement. Per-module attribution is startup-modules.json in the diff; lazy-only code in the shell fails by name against shell-boundary.json. A recorded measure with slack both ways, not a ceiling at the last measured byte, so growth is one number in the diff and the module delta says where it came from.

echartsRuntime.why: The charting runtime, already route-lazy. It is loaded only by Statistics; it must not grow, and nothing else may join it.

module.full.no-external.why: PostHog's browser library, the no-external build (docs/architecture.md): replay, surveys and exception capture bundled so nothing is ever loaded from PostHog at runtime. Loaded only after the user shares something; an install that does not share never fetches it. Pinned posthog-js; a version bump that grows it moves this number in the same change.
